Select two hosted LLMs permitted by the environment and one deterministic network verifier capable of semantic policy checking (e.g., configuration semantics / reachability/ACL effect). Implement three pipeline variants: (A) LLM-only generation, (B) LLM + single verification pass (reject-only), (C) LLM + iterative repair loop up to 5 iterations driven by verifier diagnostics. Freeze prompts, repair prompt templates, model seeds, verifier version, retry policy, and cost/latency stopping rules. Execute experiments offline; record generated configs, verifier boolean outcomes, repair edits, per-run latency, and model-call counts. Freeze exact prompt texts, model IDs, and seeds. For each task×vendor×model×prompt-variant: generate configuration, run deterministic verifier, record syntactic parse success and verifier boolean, latency, and token usage. Report percentage variance attributable to prompt vs model vs vendor, with bootstrapped CIs. Use paired comparisons (e.g., Wilcoxon signed-rank) to compare structured vs minimal prompts on verifier-pass rates. "],"proposed_design":"Preregister 200 intent tasks (balanced by type). Use one hosted LLM and deterministic verifier. Archive raw artifacts for reproducibility.","expected_data":"Per-task per-iteration records (generated config, verifier boolean, repair diff, cumulative latency, cumulative model calls). Report trade-off frontiers and recommend operational bounds under several cost/latency scenarios.","novelty_evidence_ids":["https://openalex.org/W4401857375","https://openalex.org/W4396723768","doi:10.20944/preprints202604.1820.v1"],"feasibility_evidence_ids":["https://openalex.org/W4396723768","https://openalex.org/W4401857375"],"risks":["Iterative repairs may produce oscillatory edits or semantic drift that undermines intent fidelity.","Ambiguous or adversarial intents may not converge within any practical bound, inflating unresolved fractions.","Operational latency/cost constraints might make even bounded repairs impractical in some deployment contexts."],"estimated_model_calls":800},{"candidate_id":"cand_bench_004","title":"Design and release of a verifier-grounded public NetOps dataset and benchmark for LLM evaluation","research_question":"Can a public dataset and benchmark that pairs natural-language intents with vendor-style configuration targets and verifier-grounded correctness labels be constructed to enable reproducible evaluation of LLM-driven NetOps pipelines and reveal common operational failure modes?","hypotheses":["A curated public dataset of 1,000 intent→configuration pairs with deterministic-verifier labels will enable reproducible, discriminatorily informative evaluation: leading LLMs will exhibit verifier-pass rates with inter-model spread ≥10 percentage points on the benchmark.","Providing verifier diagnostic traces and categorized failure labels (syntactic, semantic, policy-violation) will enable automated failure-mode clustering that distinguishes at least three dominant error classes across model outputs.",""],"proposed_design":"Collect and anonymize a synthetic-plus-expert-curated corpus of 1,000 NetOps intent tasks spanning ACL, BGP, VLAN, and basic routing policy templates. Release validation scripts and reproducibility checksums.","novelty_evidence_ids":["https://openalex.org/W4392875514","https://openalex.org/W4411735779"],"feasibility_evidence_ids":["https://openalex.org/W4396723768","https://openalex.org/W4401857375"],"risks":["Synthetic or curated intents may not fully capture production diversity, limiting external validity.","Legal or privacy constraints may prevent inclusion of real operator artifacts, reducing realism.","Benchmarks can be gamed by prompt- or output-formatting hacks that do not improve operational safety."],"estimated_model_calls":1200}]} for TypeAdapter(CandidateSet); 1 validation error for CandidateSet
